meta.notes: Test webhook (m2-test): GET /webhook/m2-test starts a run only while the workflow is active (testing; the schedule is the real trigger). Delete it if you do not want an HTTP trigger. Top for AI: only the 8 best jobs go to the Brain (free Gemini quota). Strict location mode drops jobs with no allowed city/remote scope; plain "Remote" stays, flagged. Remote boards (Himalayas/Remotive) fill at most 1/3 of the kept jobs.
